note: Phone cameras for shoot_guide.py and lens_look.py. Focal lengths are full-frame equivalents measured on the picture diagonal (43.27 mm), the usual meaning of '26 mm lens' on a phone. Every value carries its evidence label. Add a phone by adding an object.

iphone_14.label: iPhone 14
iphone_14._evidence: VERIFIED: com.apple.quicktime.model = 'iPhone 14' on the Hyenas takes (14 Nov 2026) and Partnership car shot IMG_6496 (read with ffprobe, 25 Nov 2026).

0.5x._: ESTIMATE: Apple lists the ultra wide as 13 mm f/2.4; 14 mm allows the same ~7 % video crop as the main camera. Not measured on a take.

1x._: ESTIMATE +/-7 %: Apple lists the main camera as 26 mm f/1.5; 4K video crops in a little, and the repo's sets already use 28 mm (blender/storm_set.json, hyenas_set.json). OBSERVED consistent with the Hyenas close-up takes at 3 ft and 5 ft: 28 mm predicts 1.23 m and 2.05 m of height in frame, which is what those frames show of a 1.905 m man.

iphone_14._no_tele: VERIFIED from Apple's model line-up: the iPhone 14 (not Pro) has no telephoto. 2x and beyond is a crop of the 1x camera, the same crop lens_look.py makes from the 4K file.
